location.anatomical: On the upper chest, 6 cun lateral to the midline, level with the first intercostal space, in the hollow below the outer end of the collarbone.
location.plain: Find the hollow just below the outer end of your collarbone, where the arm meets the chest. Zhongfu is one thumb-width below that hollow, level with the gap under your first rib.

traditional.term: Heat Excess Arising From The Middle Warmer

location.anatomical: On the upper chest, in the hollow below the outer end of the clavicle, 6 cun lateral to the midline.
location.plain: Press into the soft hollow directly below the outer end of your collarbone, near the front of the shoulder. That hollow is Yunmen.

location.anatomical: On the upper arm, 3 cun below the front axillary fold, on the outer edge of the biceps muscle.
location.plain: On the inner-front of your upper arm, four finger-widths below the front crease of the armpit, on the outer edge of the biceps.

traditional.term: Medial Aspect Of Upper Arm Pain

location.anatomical: On the upper arm, 4 cun below the front axillary fold, on the outer edge of the biceps, 1 cun below LU3.
location.plain: One thumb-width below LU3 on the outer edge of the biceps, roughly five finger-widths below the front of the armpit.

traditional.term: Medial Aspect Of Upper Arm Pain

location.anatomical: In the elbow crease, in the hollow on the thumb side of the biceps tendon.
location.plain: Bend your elbow slightly and feel the firm tendon in the middle of the crease. Chize is in the hollow just to the thumb side of that tendon.

location.anatomical: On the forearm, 7 cun above the wrist crease, on the line between LU5 and LU9.
location.plain: On the thumb side of your inner forearm, a little above the midpoint between the elbow crease and the wrist crease (about 7 thumb-widths above the wrist). Press for a tender spot.

location.anatomical: On the thumb side of the forearm, 1.5 cun above the wrist crease, in the groove above the styloid process of the radius.
location.plain: Interlock the webs of your thumbs; where the tip of the index finger lands on the other wrist, just above the bony bump on the thumb side, is Lieque, in a small groove.

traditional.plain: poor blood flow to the brain

location.anatomical: On the thumb side of the inner wrist, 1 cun above the wrist crease, between the radial artery and the radius bone.
location.plain: One thumb-width above the wrist crease on the thumb side, right next to where you feel your pulse.

location.anatomical: At the wrist crease on the thumb side, in the hollow on the outer side of the radial artery.
location.plain: On the inner wrist crease, on the thumb side, where you feel your pulse. Taiyuan is in the hollow just to the thumb side of the pulse.

location.anatomical: On the palm side of the hand, at the midpoint of the first metacarpal bone, at the border between the red and white skin.
location.plain: Find the fleshy mound at the base of your thumb. Yuji is in the middle of that mound, on its edge where the darker palm skin meets the lighter skin of the back of the hand.

location.anatomical: On the thumb, 0.1 cun from the corner of the nail on the outer (radial) side.
location.plain: At the corner of the thumbnail on the side away from the fingers, about 2 mm from the nail.

location.anatomical: On the index finger, 0.1 cun from the corner of the nail on the thumb side.
location.plain: At the corner of the index fingernail on the thumb side, about 2 mm from the nail.

location.anatomical: On the index finger, in the hollow on the thumb side just below the knuckle at the base of the finger, at the border of red and white skin.
location.plain: Make a loose fist. On the thumb side of the index finger, just in front of the big knuckle, in the hollow where the skin colour changes.

location.anatomical: On the back of the hand, on the thumb side of the index finger, in the hollow just behind the knuckle at the base of the finger.
location.plain: Make a loose fist. On the thumb side of the index finger, just behind the big knuckle (toward the wrist), in the hollow.

traditional.plain: swelling on the back of the hand

location.anatomical: On the back of the hand, between the first and second metacarpal bones, at the midpoint of the second metacarpal on the thumb side.
location.plain: Squeeze your thumb and index finger together; Hegu is at the highest point of the muscle bulge in the web between them. Press toward the bone of the index finger for a strong ache. Avoid in pregnancy.

reviews.claim: Acupressure (mostly at LI4 and SP6) may modestly relieve pain during labour; evidence low to moderate quality.
reviews.cite: Smith CA, Collins CT, Levett KM, Armour M, Dahlen HG, Tan AL, Mesgarpour B. Acupuncture or acupressure for pain management during labour. Cochrane Database Syst Rev 2020. DOI 10.1002/14651858.CD009232.pub2

reviews.claim: Acupuncture (LI4 is among the most-used points) is effective for frequent episodic or chronic tension-type headache.
reviews.cite: Linde K, Allais G, Brinkhaus B, et al. Acupuncture for the prevention of tension-type headache. Cochrane Database Syst Rev 2016;(4):CD007587. DOI 10.1002/14651858.CD007587.pub2

location.anatomical: On the thumb side of the wrist, in the hollow between the two tendons of the thumb (the anatomical snuffbox).
location.plain: Stretch your thumb out and back; a small triangular hollow appears at the base of the thumb on the wrist. Yangxi is in that hollow.

location.anatomical: On the thumb side of the forearm, 3 cun above the wrist crease, on the line from LI5 to LI11.
location.plain: Four finger-widths above the wrist on the thumb side of the back of the forearm, along the line running to the outer elbow.

location.anatomical: On the thumb side of the forearm, 5 cun above the wrist crease, on the line from LI5 to LI11.
location.plain: Halfway between the wrist and the elbow on the thumb-side edge of the back of the forearm, then a little toward the wrist (5 thumb-widths above the wrist).

location.anatomical: On the thumb side of the forearm, 4 cun below the elbow crease, on the line from LI5 to LI11.
location.plain: On the thumb-side edge of the forearm, four thumb-widths below the outer end of the elbow crease.

location.anatomical: On the thumb side of the forearm, 3 cun below the elbow crease, on the line from LI5 to LI11.
location.plain: Four finger-widths below the outer end of the elbow crease, on the thumb-side edge of the forearm.

location.anatomical: On the thumb side of the forearm, 2 cun below the elbow crease, on the line from LI5 to LI11.
location.plain: Bend your elbow. Three finger-widths below the outer end of the elbow crease, on the fleshy muscle of the forearm. Usually quite tender.

location.anatomical: At the outer end of the elbow crease, midway between the biceps tendon and the bony knob of the outer elbow.
location.plain: Bend your elbow fully. Quchi is at the outer end of the elbow crease, in the hollow between the crease and the bony point of the elbow.

location.anatomical: On the outer upper arm, 1 cun above LI11, on the ridge of bone above the elbow.
location.plain: One thumb-width above the outer end of the elbow crease, on the edge of the bone of the upper arm.

location.anatomical: On the outer upper arm, 3 cun above LI11, on the line from LI11 to LI15.
location.plain: Four finger-widths above the outer end of the elbow crease, on the outer side of the upper arm.

location.anatomical: On the outer upper arm, at the insertion of the deltoid muscle, 7 cun above LI11.
location.plain: On the outer upper arm, where the lower tip of the shoulder muscle (deltoid) ends, about three-quarters of the way up from the elbow toward the shoulder (7 thumb-widths above the outer elbow crease).

location.anatomical: On the shoulder, in the front hollow that appears below the tip of the shoulder bone when the arm is raised sideways.
location.plain: Raise your arm out to the side: two hollows appear at the tip of the shoulder. Jianyu is the front one.

location.anatomical: On the shoulder, in the hollow between the outer end of the collarbone and the spine of the shoulder blade.
location.plain: On top of the shoulder, in the dip just inside the outer end of the collarbone, between the collarbone and the ridge of the shoulder blade.

location.anatomical: On the side of the neck, 1 cun below LI18, on the rear edge of the sternocleidomastoid muscle.
location.plain: On the side of the neck, one thumb-width below LI18, behind the big neck muscle, level with the lower edge of the Adam's apple.

location.anatomical: On the side of the neck, level with the tip of the Adam's apple, between the two heads of the sternocleidomastoid muscle.
location.plain: Turn your head slightly; the big neck muscle stands out. Futu is level with the Adam's apple, in the middle of that muscle.

location.anatomical: On the upper lip, directly below the outer edge of the nostril, level with the midpoint of the philtrum.
location.plain: On the upper lip, straight below the outer edge of your nostril, halfway between nose and lip.

location.anatomical: In the groove beside the nose, level with the midpoint of the outer edge of the nostril.
location.plain: In the crease that runs from the nose to the corner of the mouth, right beside the widest part of the nostril.

location.anatomical: On the face, between the eyeball and the lower rim of the eye socket, directly below the pupil.
location.plain: Look straight ahead. Just below the lower eyelid, on the rim of the eye socket, directly under the pupil. Press very gently on the bone.

location.anatomical: On the face, in the hollow of the infraorbital foramen, directly below the pupil.
location.plain: Directly below the pupil, about one thumb-width below the lower eyelid, in a small hollow in the cheekbone.

location.anatomical: On the face, directly below the pupil, level with the lower edge of the nostril.
location.plain: Directly below the pupil, level with the bottom of the nose, on the cheek.

location.anatomical: On the face, 0.4 cun lateral to the corner of the mouth.
location.plain: Just beside the corner of the mouth, about half a thumb-width out.

location.anatomical: On the lower jaw, in front of the angle of the jaw, in the groove on the front edge of the masseter muscle, over the facial artery.
location.plain: Clench your teeth to feel the jaw muscle bulge. Daying is in the notch just in front of that muscle, on the edge of the jawbone, where a pulse can be felt.

location.anatomical: On the cheek, one finger-width above and in front of the angle of the jaw, at the prominence of the masseter muscle when the teeth are clenched.
location.plain: Clench your teeth; the jaw muscle bulges. Jiache is at the high point of that bulge, about one finger-width up and forward from the angle of the jaw.

location.anatomical: On the face, in the hollow below the zygomatic arch, in front of the condyle of the jaw.
location.plain: Close your mouth. Just in front of the ear, below the cheekbone arch, is a hollow that disappears when you open your mouth. That hollow is Xiaguan.

location.anatomical: On the head, 0.5 cun above the corner of the forehead hairline, 4.5 cun lateral to the midline.
location.plain: At the corner of the forehead where the hairline turns down toward the temple, half a thumb-width inside the hairline.

location.anatomical: On the neck, level with the tip of the Adam's apple, on the front edge of the sternocleidomastoid muscle, over the carotid artery.
location.plain: Beside the Adam's apple, on the front edge of the big neck muscle, where you feel the pulse of the carotid artery. Do not press firmly.

location.anatomical: On the neck, on the front edge of the sternocleidomastoid muscle, midway between ST9 and ST11.
location.plain: On the front edge of the big neck muscle, halfway between the Adam's apple level and the collarbone.

location.anatomical: On the neck, on the upper edge of the inner end of the clavicle, between the two heads of the sternocleidomastoid muscle.
location.plain: Just above the collarbone near its inner end, in the small dip between the two bands of the big neck muscle.

location.anatomical: On the neck, in the centre of the hollow above the clavicle, 4 cun lateral to the midline.
location.plain: In the middle of the deep hollow above the collarbone, on a line straight down from the nipple (men) or mid-collarbone. Press gently.

location.anatomical: On the chest, in the hollow below the clavicle, 4 cun lateral to the midline.
location.plain: Just below the collarbone, on the line straight down from its middle (about four thumb-widths from the centre of the chest).

traditional.plain: pain under the ribs at the side

location.anatomical: On the chest, in the first intercostal space, 4 cun lateral to the midline.
location.plain: In the gap between the first and second ribs, on the nipple line (four thumb-widths from the centre line).

location.anatomical: On the chest, in the second intercostal space, 4 cun lateral to the midline.
location.plain: In the gap between the second and third ribs, on the nipple line.

location.anatomical: On the chest, in the third intercostal space, 4 cun lateral to the midline.
location.plain: In the gap between the third and fourth ribs, on the nipple line, one rib space above the nipple.

traditional.plain: pain under the ribs at the side
fullness under the ribs at the side

location.anatomical: On the chest, in the fourth intercostal space, at the centre of the nipple.
location.plain: The centre of the nipple. A reference point only; it is not pressed or needled.

location.anatomical: On the chest, in the fifth intercostal space, 4 cun lateral to the midline, at the root of the breast.
location.plain: Directly below the nipple, in the gap between the fifth and sixth ribs, at the base of the breast.

location.anatomical: On the upper abdomen, 6 cun above the navel, 2 cun lateral to the midline.
location.plain: Three finger-widths out from the centre line, just below the lower edge of the ribcage near the breastbone.

location.anatomical: On the upper abdomen, 5 cun above the navel, 2 cun lateral to the midline.
location.plain: Three finger-widths to the side of the midline, five thumb-widths above the navel.

location.anatomical: On the upper abdomen, 4 cun above the navel, 2 cun lateral to the midline.
location.plain: Three finger-widths to the side of the midline, halfway between the navel and the bottom of the breastbone.

location.anatomical: On the upper abdomen, 3 cun above the navel, 2 cun lateral to the midline.
location.plain: Four finger-widths above the navel, three finger-widths to the side.

location.anatomical: On the upper abdomen, 2 cun above the navel, 2 cun lateral to the midline.
location.plain: Three finger-widths above the navel and three finger-widths to the side.

location.anatomical: On the upper abdomen, 1 cun above the navel, 2 cun lateral to the midline.
location.plain: One thumb-width above the navel and three finger-widths to the side.

location.anatomical: On the abdomen, 2 cun lateral to the centre of the navel.
location.plain: Three finger-widths directly to the side of the navel.

location.anatomical: On the lower abdomen, 1 cun below the navel, 2 cun lateral to the midline.
location.plain: One thumb-width below the navel and three finger-widths to the side.

location.anatomical: On the lower abdomen, 2 cun below the navel, 2 cun lateral to the midline.
location.plain: Three finger-widths below the navel and three finger-widths to the side.

location.anatomical: On the lower abdomen, 3 cun below the navel, 2 cun lateral to the midline.
location.plain: Four finger-widths below the navel and three finger-widths to the side.

location.anatomical: On the lower abdomen, 4 cun below the navel, 2 cun lateral to the midline.
location.plain: One thumb-width above the pubic bone, three finger-widths to the side of the midline.

location.anatomical: On the groin, level with the upper edge of the pubic bone, 2 cun lateral to the midline, over the femoral artery.
location.plain: Just above the pubic bone, three finger-widths to the side of the midline, in the groin crease where a pulse can be felt. Press gently.

location.anatomical: On the front of the thigh, in the hollow between the sartorius and tensor fasciae latae, on the line from the hip bone to the outer edge of the kneecap, level with the crease below the buttock.
location.plain: Sit with your thigh flexed; a hollow appears on the front-outer thigh just below the bony point of the hip. Biguan is in that hollow, level with the pubic bone.

location.anatomical: On the front of the thigh, 6 cun above the upper outer corner of the kneecap, on the line to the hip bone.
location.plain: On the front-outer thigh, about a hand-length (6 thumb-widths) above the outer top corner of the kneecap. The muscle bulges here when you tense the thigh.

traditional.plain: leg weakness and swelling (vitamin B1 deficiency)

location.anatomical: On the front of the thigh, 3 cun above the upper outer corner of the kneecap, on the line to the hip bone.
location.plain: Four finger-widths above the outer top corner of the kneecap, on the front-outer thigh.

location.anatomical: On the front of the thigh, 2 cun above the upper outer corner of the kneecap, between the vastus lateralis and the rectus femoris tendon.
location.plain: Three finger-widths above the outer top corner of the kneecap, in a hollow on the outer side of the thigh muscle. Often tender.

location.anatomical: On the knee, in the hollow below the kneecap, on the outer side of the patellar ligament.
location.plain: Bend your knee. Just below the kneecap, two dimples appear either side of the thick tendon. Dubi is the outer dimple.

traditional.plain: leg weakness and swelling (vitamin B1 deficiency)

location.anatomical: On the lower leg, 3 cun below ST35, one finger-width lateral to the front edge of the tibia.
location.plain: On your lower leg, about four finger-widths below the bottom of the kneecap and one finger-width to the outside of the shinbone, on the muscle. Press and you will feel a dull ache.

traditional.plain: leg weakness and swelling (vitamin B1 deficiency)

location.anatomical: On the lower leg, 6 cun below ST35, one finger-width lateral to the front edge of the tibia.
location.plain: Four finger-widths below ST36 (eight below the kneecap), one finger-width outside the shinbone.

traditional.plain: leg weakness and swelling (vitamin B1 deficiency)

location.anatomical: On the lower leg, 8 cun below ST35, one finger-width lateral to the front edge of the tibia, midway between the knee and the ankle.
location.plain: Halfway between the outer knee dimple and the front of the ankle, one finger-width outside the shinbone.

location.anatomical: On the lower leg, 9 cun below ST35, one finger-width lateral to the front edge of the tibia.
location.plain: One thumb-width below ST38 (halfway down the shin), one finger-width outside the shinbone.

traditional.plain: back pain spreading to the testicles

location.anatomical: On the lower leg, 8 cun above the outer ankle, two finger-widths lateral to the front edge of the tibia, level with ST38.
location.plain: Halfway between the knee dimple and the outer ankle, then two finger-widths out from the shinbone, on the muscle.

location.anatomical: On the front of the ankle, in the centre of the ankle crease, in the hollow between the two long extensor tendons.
location.plain: Pull your toes up toward you; two tendons stand out across the front of the ankle. Jiexi is in the hollow between them, in the middle of the ankle crease.

location.anatomical: On the top of the foot, at the joint between the base of the second metatarsal bone and the intermediate cuneiform bone, at the highest point of the instep, where the pulse of the dorsalis pedis artery is felt.
location.plain: At the highest point of the top of the foot, in line with the second toe, where you can feel a pulse.

location.anatomical: On the top of the foot, in the hollow just behind the joint between the second and third metatarsal bones.
location.plain: On the top of the foot, in the groove between the bones leading to the second and third toes, about a thumb-width above the web.

traditional.plain: pain on top of the foot

location.anatomical: On the top of the foot, between the second and third toes, just behind the web margin.
location.plain: On the top of the foot, at the web between the second and third toes, slightly toward the ankle.

traditional.plain: pain on top of the foot

location.anatomical: On the second toe, 0.1 cun from the outer corner of the nail.
location.plain: At the corner of the second toenail on the side toward the third toe, about 2 mm from the nail.

location.anatomical: On the big toe, 0.1 cun from the inner corner of the nail.
location.plain: At the inner corner of the big toenail (the side facing the other foot), about 2 mm from the nail.

location.anatomical: On the inner side of the big toe, in the hollow just in front of the joint at the base of the toe, at the border of red and white skin.
location.plain: On the inner edge of the foot, just in front of the big bump at the base of the big toe (toward the toe), where the sole skin meets the top skin.

location.anatomical: On the inner side of the foot, in the hollow just behind the joint at the base of the big toe, at the border of red and white skin.
location.plain: On the inner edge of the foot, just behind the big bump at the base of the big toe (toward the heel), where the sole skin meets the top skin.

traditional.plain: leg weakness and swelling (vitamin B1 deficiency)

location.anatomical: On the inner side of the foot, in the hollow below the base of the first metatarsal bone, at the border of red and white skin.
location.plain: Run your thumb along the inner edge of the foot from the big-toe joint toward the heel; about three to four finger-widths back (roughly a third of the way to the heel) you drop off the end of the long bone into a hollow. Gongsun is in that hollow, just in front of and below the end of the bone.

location.anatomical: On the inner ankle, in the hollow in front of and below the inner ankle bone, between the tubercle of the navicular bone and the tip of the malleolus.
location.plain: Just in front of and below the inner ankle bone, in the hollow halfway to the bump on the inner side of the foot.

location.anatomical: On the inner lower leg, 3 cun above the tip of the inner ankle bone, just behind the inner edge of the tibia.
location.plain: Place four fingers on the inner lower leg with the little finger on top of the inner ankle bone. Sanyinjiao is just above the index finger, right behind the edge of the shinbone. Avoid in pregnancy.

reviews.cite: Chen MN, Chien LW, Liu CF. Acupuncture or acupressure at the Sanyinjiao (SP6) acupoint for the treatment of primary dysmenorrhea: a meta-analysis. Evid Based Complement Alternat Med 2013;2013:493038.

location.anatomical: On the inner lower leg, 6 cun above the tip of the inner ankle bone, just behind the inner edge of the tibia.
location.plain: Four finger-widths above SP6 on the inner leg, behind the edge of the shinbone.

location.anatomical: On the inner lower leg, 3 cun below SP9, just behind the inner edge of the tibia.
location.plain: Four finger-widths below the inner knee hollow (SP9), on the inner lower leg behind the shinbone. Often tender.

location.anatomical: On the inner knee, in the hollow below the inner condyle of the tibia, between the rear edge of the tibia and the calf muscle.
location.plain: Run your thumb up the inner edge of the shinbone toward the knee until it stops in a hollow below the knee. That hollow is Yinlingquan.

location.anatomical: On the inner thigh, 2 cun above the upper inner corner of the kneecap, on the bulge of the vastus medialis muscle.
location.plain: Straighten and tense the leg; a muscle bulges on the inner thigh just above the knee. Xuehai is on that bulge, three finger-widths above the inner top corner of the kneecap.

location.anatomical: On the inner thigh, at the junction of the upper third and lower two-thirds of the line from the inner end of the base of the kneecap to SP12, between the sartorius and adductor longus, over the femoral artery.
location.plain: On the inner thigh, about two-thirds of the way up from the inner knee toward the groin crease, in the groove between the muscles where a pulse can be felt.

location.anatomical: In the groin, level with the upper edge of the pubic bone, 3.5 cun lateral to the midline, on the outer side of the femoral artery.
location.plain: In the groin crease, just outside the point where you feel the pulse, level with the top of the pubic bone.

location.anatomical: On the lower abdomen, 0.7 cun above SP12, 4 cun lateral to the midline.
location.plain: A little above the groin crease, about four thumb-widths out from the midline.

location.anatomical: On the lower abdomen, 1.3 cun below the navel, 4 cun lateral to the midline.
location.plain: Just below the navel level, four thumb-widths out to the side.

location.anatomical: On the abdomen, 4 cun lateral to the centre of the navel.
location.plain: Four thumb-widths straight out from the navel, roughly in line with the nipple.

location.anatomical: On the upper abdomen, 3 cun above the navel, 4 cun lateral to the midline.
location.plain: Four finger-widths above the navel and four thumb-widths to the side, just below the ribcage.

location.anatomical: On the chest, in the fifth intercostal space, 6 cun lateral to the midline.
location.plain: On the side of the chest, in the gap between the fifth and sixth ribs, about one hand-width out from the centre line.

traditional.plain: pain under the ribs at the side
fullness under the ribs at the side

location.anatomical: On the chest, in the fourth intercostal space, 6 cun lateral to the midline.
location.plain: On the side of the chest at nipple level, two thumb-widths outside the nipple line.

traditional.plain: pain under the ribs at the side
fullness under the ribs at the side

location.anatomical: On the chest, in the third intercostal space, 6 cun lateral to the midline.
location.plain: One rib space above nipple level, two thumb-widths outside the nipple line.

traditional.plain: pain under the ribs at the side
fullness under the ribs at the side

location.anatomical: On the chest, in the second intercostal space, 6 cun lateral to the midline.
location.plain: Two rib spaces above nipple level, two thumb-widths outside the nipple line, below the front of the shoulder.

traditional.plain: fullness under the ribs at the side

location.anatomical: On the side of the chest, on the mid-axillary line, in the sixth intercostal space.
location.plain: On the side of the ribcage, straight down from the middle of the armpit, about a hand-width below it, in a rib space.

traditional.plain: pain under the ribs at the side

location.anatomical: At the top of the armpit, on the inner side of the axillary artery.
location.plain: At the very top of the armpit, just inside where you feel the pulse.

location.anatomical: On the inner upper arm, 3 cun above the elbow crease, in the groove on the inner side of the biceps.
location.plain: Four finger-widths above the inner end of the elbow crease, in the groove along the inner edge of the biceps.

traditional.plain: pain under the ribs at the side

location.anatomical: At the inner end of the elbow crease, when the elbow is bent, in the hollow in front of the inner elbow bone.
location.plain: Bend your elbow fully. Shaohai is at the inner end of the crease, between the crease and the bony knob on the inner elbow.

traditional.plain: pain under the ribs at the side

location.anatomical: On the inner forearm, 1.5 cun above the wrist crease, on the thumb side of the tendon of flexor carpi ulnaris.
location.plain: On the little-finger side of the inner forearm, two finger-widths above the wrist crease, just to the thumb side of the tendon that runs to the little-finger side of the wrist.

location.anatomical: On the inner forearm, 1 cun above the wrist crease, on the thumb side of the tendon of flexor carpi ulnaris.
location.plain: One thumb-width above the wrist crease on the little-finger side of the inner forearm, beside the tendon.

location.anatomical: On the inner forearm, 0.5 cun above the wrist crease, on the thumb side of the tendon of flexor carpi ulnaris.
location.plain: Half a thumb-width above the wrist crease on the little-finger side, beside the tendon.

location.anatomical: At the wrist crease, in the hollow on the thumb side of the tendon of flexor carpi ulnaris, at the edge of the pisiform bone.
location.plain: On the inner wrist crease, on the little-finger side, in the small hollow just beside the tendon, next to the small round wrist bone.

location.plain: On the midline, half a thumb-width inside the front hairline.

location.anatomical: On the face, at the centre of the tip of the nose.
location.plain: The very tip of the nose.

location.anatomical: On the face, on the midline of the philtrum, at the junction of the upper third and lower two-thirds.
location.plain: In the groove between the nose and upper lip, a third of the way down from the nose.

location.anatomical: On the face, on the midline, at the junction of the upper lip and the philtrum (the tubercle of the upper lip).
location.plain: On the midline, at the top edge of the upper lip where the red of the lip meets the skin.

location.anatomical: In the mouth, on the midline, at the junction of the upper gum and the frenulum of the upper lip.
location.plain: Inside the mouth, where the thin band of tissue under the upper lip meets the gum. Not for pressing.

location.anatomical: On the forehead, on the midline, at the midpoint between the inner ends of the eyebrows.
location.plain: Between the eyebrows, on the midline, in the small dip at the top of the nose bridge.

location.anatomical: On the perineum, at the midpoint between the anus and the genitals.
location.plain: Midway between the anus and the genitals. A professional point; not for self-pressing.

location.anatomical: On the lower abdomen, on the midline, at the upper edge of the pubic bone, 5 cun below the navel.
location.plain: On the midline, just at the top edge of the pubic bone.

location.anatomical: On the lower abdomen, on the midline, 4 cun below the navel.
location.plain: On the midline, one thumb-width above the pubic bone (four thumb-widths below the navel).

location.anatomical: On the lower abdomen, on the midline, 3 cun below the navel.
location.plain: On the midline, four finger-widths below the navel.

location.anatomical: On the upper abdomen, on the midline, 1 cun above the navel.
location.plain: On the midline, one thumb-width above the navel.

location.anatomical: On the upper abdomen, on the midline, 2 cun above the navel.
location.plain: On the midline, three finger-widths above the navel.

location.anatomical: On the upper abdomen, on the midline, 3 cun above the navel.
location.plain: On the midline, four finger-widths above the navel.

location.anatomical: On the upper abdomen, on the midline, 4 cun above the navel, midway between the navel and the bottom of the breastbone.
location.plain: On the midline, exactly halfway between the navel and the bottom tip of the breastbone.

location.anatomical: On the upper abdomen, on the midline, 5 cun above the navel.
location.plain: On the midline, one thumb-width above CV12 (halfway point between navel and breastbone).

location.anatomical: On the upper abdomen, on the midline, 6 cun above the navel.
location.plain: On the midline, about one thumb-width below the bottom tip of the breastbone.

location.anatomical: On the upper abdomen, on the midline, 7 cun above the navel, just below the xiphoid process.
location.plain: On the midline, just below the small pointed tip at the bottom of the breastbone. Press gently.

location.anatomical: On the chest, on the midline, level with the fifth intercostal space, at the junction of the sternum and the xiphoid.
location.plain: On the midline, at the bottom of the breastbone where it meets the small pointed tip.

location.anatomical: On the chest, on the midline, level with the fourth intercostal space, at the midpoint between the nipples.
location.plain: On the centre of the breastbone, level with the nipples.

location.anatomical: On the chest, on the midline, level with the third intercostal space.
location.plain: On the centre of the breastbone, one rib space above nipple level.

location.anatomical: On the chest, on the midline, level with the second intercostal space.
location.plain: On the centre of the breastbone, two rib spaces above nipple level.

location.anatomical: On the chest, on the midline, level with the first intercostal space.
location.plain: On the centre of the breastbone, one rib space below the top of the breastbone.

location.anatomical: On the chest, on the midline, 1 cun below CV22, at the midpoint of the manubrium.
location.plain: On the midline, one thumb-width below the notch at the top of the breastbone.

location.anatomical: On the neck, on the midline, in the centre of the suprasternal notch, 0.5 cun above the top of the sternum.
location.plain: In the hollow at the base of the throat, just above the top of the breastbone. Press gently downward onto the bone, never inward.

location.anatomical: On the neck, on the midline, above the Adam's apple, in the hollow above the hyoid bone.
location.plain: Tilt your head back slightly. On the midline above the Adam's apple, in the soft hollow under the chin, just above the small horizontal bone (hyoid).

location.anatomical: On the face, on the midline, in the hollow in the centre of the chin-lip groove.
location.plain: In the middle of the groove between the lower lip and the chin.

location.anatomical: On the head, a group of four points 1 cun in front of, behind and to each side of GV20.
location.plain: Four points around the crown: one thumb-width in front, behind, left and right of Baihui (GV20).

location.anatomical: On the head, 1 cun inside the front hairline, directly above the pupil.
location.plain: One thumb-width inside the front hairline, straight above the pupil (level with GV23 on the midline).

location.anatomical: On the forehead, at the midpoint of the eyebrow, directly above the pupil.
location.plain: In the middle of the eyebrow, straight above the pupil when looking ahead.

location.anatomical: On the temple, in the hollow about one finger-width behind the midpoint between the outer end of the eyebrow and the outer corner of the eye.
location.plain: Find the midpoint between the outer tip of the eyebrow and the outer corner of the eye, then move one finger-width back toward the ear into the soft hollow of the temple.

location.anatomical: On the ear, at the apex of the auricle when the ear is folded forward.
location.plain: Fold the ear forward; Erjian is at the highest point of the fold, on the rim of the ear.

location.anatomical: On the face, at the junction of the outer quarter and inner three-quarters of the lower rim of the eye socket.
location.plain: On the lower rim of the eye socket, a quarter of the way in from the outer corner. Needling point only; do not press.

location.anatomical: On the face, at the upper end of the nasolabial groove, at the junction of the nasal ala and the cheek.
location.plain: At the top of the crease beside the nose, where the side of the nostril meets the cheek, just above LI20.

location.anatomical: Inside the nostril, at the junction of the nasal ala cartilage and the turbinate.
location.plain: Inside the nostril. Not suitable for acupressure.

location.anatomical: On the midline of the upper surface of the tongue, at the midpoint.
location.plain: On top of the tongue, in the centre. Not suitable for acupressure.

location.anatomical: On the underside of the tongue, at the midpoint of the frenulum.
location.plain: Under the tongue, in the middle of the thin band of tissue. Not suitable for acupressure.

location.anatomical: On the underside of the tongue, on the vein to the left of the frenulum.
location.plain: Under the tongue, on the vein to the left of the central band. Not suitable for acupressure.

location.anatomical: On the underside of the tongue, on the vein to the right of the frenulum.
location.plain: Under the tongue, on the vein to the right of the central band. Not suitable for acupressure.

location.anatomical: Behind the ear, 1 cun behind TE17, below the mastoid process.
location.plain: One thumb-width behind the hollow behind the earlobe (TE17), just under the bony bump behind the ear.

location.anatomical: On the back of the neck, 2 cun above GV14 and 1 cun lateral to the midline.
location.plain: Three finger-widths above the big bump at the base of the neck, one thumb-width to the side of the midline.

location.anatomical: Behind the ear, at the midpoint between TE17 and GB20.
location.plain: Behind the ear, halfway between the hollow behind the earlobe (TE17) and the hollow at the base of the skull (GB20).
